# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest released version of decopin-cli is supported with security updates.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report suspected security vulnerabilities privately through [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/yuyakinjo/decopin-cli/security/advisories/new).

Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability. Include clear reproduction steps, the affected version, and any known impact. The report will be reviewed privately, and disclosure will be coordinated after a fix is available.
